mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id, document_type, title FROM archive_document WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND document_type = #{documentType} LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no), 0) + 1 FROM archive_version WHERE document_id = #{documentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archive_document (employee_id, document_type, title) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{documentType}, #{title})
INSERT INTO file_object (object_key, original_name, content_type, byte_size, sha256) VALUES (#{objectKey}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{size}, #{sha256})

INSERT INTO archive_version (document_id, version_no, file_object_id, original_name, content_type, byte_size, sha256, status, is_current, created_at, created_by, change_reason) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{versionNo}, #{fileObjectId}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{size}, #{sha256}, #{status}, #{isCurrent}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{changeReason})
mapper.update: UPDATE archive_version SET is_current = FALSE WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND is_current = TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT f.object_key FROM file_object f JOIN archive_version v ON v.file_object_id = f.id WHERE v.id = #{versionId}
